_about: Spec 17 water context actions (WaterAccess, scripts/player/water_access.gd). PRD :105 drink / wash / fill container prompts on or near water; :314 fresh water: drink cuts heat fatigue, wash clears dirty, fill containers; :315 seawater is salt. Fresh water is the river (terrain under the water plane on the river's MUD tiles); the sea gives no hexes and makes a survivor standing in it Thirsty (research systems 1.3: 'river/puddle, not sea'; world-environment: 'Thirst +20% from seawater'). The statuses and their fatigue effects are in statuses.json (dirty, very_dirty, thirsty, quenched, clean); there is no thirst, hunger or hygiene meter (PRD :72, 6.3, :1030).
_reach_m: ASSUMPTION: Drink / Wash / Fill show while fresh water is within about this many metres of the survivor's feet (PRD :105 says 'on/near', no number).

dirt._about: ASSUMPTION: the PRD makes dirt a fatigue cause (:415, :434, :447) without saying what makes you dirty. Work adds grime points per cause: one gathered unit, one butchered loot stack, one hit taken. Dirty at dirty_at, Very dirty at very_dirty_at; washing resets the count. Points are hidden, never shown as a meter.
